contexts.text: This desolation is also called emptying, consummation, etc.
They either empty their ideas, or confine them.
While the Lord was in the world, He had two states, one of which is called a state of humiliation or exinanition... DLW 234.
They wanted to adduce such things as the Lord spake... in the state of exinanition...
That the progression to union was his state of exinanition...

The first state, which was one of exinanition, is described in many places in the Word, especially in the Psalms of David and in the Prophets, and particularly in  where it is said that He emptied out His soul even unto death. This same state was His state of humiliation before the Father; for in it He prayed to the Father, and says that He does His will, and ascribes to the Father all that He had done or spoken. Illustrated. Nay, upon the cross, He cried out, My God, My God, why dost Thou forsake Me? and morever, without this state He could not have been crucified. TCR 110:4. CanonsNC 19. Redeemer. 2. 3.
To empty out and spoil the land () = the desolation of the Church as to the truths of doctrine and of faith.
Redeemer. 6. 4. When the Lord was in the Divine truth apart, He was in a state of exinanition.
Redeemer. 7. 8. He underwent temptations and reprobations while He was in a state of truth apart, which was His state of exinanition.
Redeemer. 9. 9. When He was in the human of the mother, Christ was in the state of exinanition, and could be tempted, and rejected, and could suffer.
